reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing shared getScheduledAmount/getExpectedAmount helpers that every consumer (API model, forecast, schedules app, budget templates, UI) already calls.

duplication.why: No logic is added outside the shared helpers; the change actually simplifies them (Math.min, single subtraction of the tolerance).

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the module this tree uses for schedule amount semantics.

scope.why: Only the two helpers, their tests, the API-model test expectations and the matching release notes change.

maintainability.why: The worst-case rule is now expressed once, compactly, and all call sites follow it automatically.
